guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：物件儲存系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Object-storage systems
guides.concept: 以物件 API、版本與分佈式耐久性連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect object apis, versions and distributed durability through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Key 命名」的資料、控制與時間關係。物件 key 不一定是真正的目錄。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較 prefix 與目錄移動需求。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Multipart」的資料、控制與時間關係。分段上傳需完整提交與殘留清理。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤成功與未完成上傳。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編碼池」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料編碼與 metadata 策略可不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較資料與索引復原責任。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「生命週期」的資料、控制與時間關係。到期政策需考慮法律保存與還原需求。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較資料與未完成段到期。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「容量保留」的資料、控制與時間關係。剩餘空間需吸收失效及重建。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核算本課 20% headroom。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「修復驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。存活物件數不能替代逐物件摘要。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較修復前後版本與摘要。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for key naming. Object keys need not represent real directories. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare prefixes and directory-move needs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for multipart. Multipart uploads need completion and residue cleanup. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace complete and incomplete uploads. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coded pools. Data coding and metadata policy may differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare data and index recovery roles. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for lifecycle. Expiry policy accounts for retention and recovery. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare object and unfinished-part expiry. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for capacity headroom. Free space absorbs failures and rebuilds. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit the 20% headroom example. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for repair acceptance. Live object count cannot replace per-object digests. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare versions and digests across repair. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「流量費用」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立假想每月成本表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「修復驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「存活物件數不能替代逐物件摘要。」。
提交「修復驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較修復前後版本與摘要。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit transfer costs input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit repair acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit repair acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：不同磁碟自然就有獨立故障概率。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Different disks automatically have independent failures. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

related.title: 分散式檔案系統
related.why: 複製、編碼與容量預算共用
related.whyEn: Replication, coding and capacity budgets transfer
related.transfer: 複製、編碼與容量預算共用
related.transferEn: Replication, coding and capacity budgets transfer
related.difference: 物件服務語義需重查，不能假設檔案 rename 或局部覆寫
related.differenceEn: Object semantics need rechecking for rename/random overwrite
practice: 由「Key 命名」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「物件服務語義需重查，不能假設檔案 rename 或局部覆寫」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From key naming, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Object semantics need rechecking for rename/random overwrite", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
